question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0671a651301be085886710a64bbe62cac655143b1a0dd99dd73e110750824c83.png]
solution: The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles = [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 × 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3
